description: At an asking price of Rs. 12,995, the Nike Pegasus 42 doesn't try to compete with the exotic running shoes that cost twice as much and also break down after a few hundred kilometres. Instead, this one is positioned much more smartly and is an excellent mid-range daily driver. Here's our review.
title: Nike Pegasus 42 Review: The 'iPhone' of Running Shoes Proves Its Mettle

description: Polish cryptocurrency exchange Kanga has obtained a Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) licence from Latvia, allowing it to provide regulated crypto services across the European Union through passporting. The approval comes just ahead of the EU's July 1 MiCA deadline and follows Poland's delay in implementing the regulation domestically. The licence authorises Kanga to offer services including crypto custody, trading, and transfers throughout the bloc.
title: Polish Exchange Kanga Granted MiCA Licence in Latvia, Set to Offer Services Across Europe

description: Honor X80 Pro Max, with a massive 11,000mAh silicon-carbon battery, was launched in China earlier this month. This phone is advertised to deliver a standby time of 42 days on a single charge. Now, new leaks coming out of China suggest that a smartphone brand is developing a device with a higher battery capacity than 11,000mAh.
title: Honor Could Be Developing a Smartphone With a Massive 14,000mAh Battery

description: Google has reportedly started testing a new iOS-like feature that lets users create an album to shuffle through on their handset. Dubbed Photo Shuffle, the functionality was reportedly spotted during an APK teardown of the latest Android 17 Quarterly Platform Release 1 (QPR1) beta 5 update, which was released by the Mountain View-based tech giant on June 23. According to the screenshots shared by the publication, Photo Shuffle appears in a separate window. The page reads, “Create an album of your favourite people and pets to auto-refresh your wallpaper”.
title: Android 17 QPR1 Beta 5 Update Reportedly Includes Hints of a New iOS-Like Wallpaper Shuffle Feature

description: iPhone Ultra 2 will be equipped with a wider-folding display than the yet-to-be-unveiled iPhone Ultra, a tipster claims. The new Ultra series handset is expected to launch globally later this year, accompanied by the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. While its anticipated launch is still months away, new details have already started surfacing online. The wide-folding smartphone is also expected to feature a dual rear camera unit, housed inside a horizontal camera module. The phone might arrive as Apple’s first foldable. Separately, the leaker claims that the company has yet to start the development of the iPhone Air 3.
title: iPhone Ultra 2 Tipped to Sport a Wider Display Than Apple’s First Foldable Phone

description: Samsung Galaxy A27 5G launched with a 6.7-inch AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate. It runs on a Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 processor paired with up to 8GB of RAM. It has a triple rear camera unit and a 5,000mAh battery with support for 25W fast charging. It will be available for purchase in India starting July 3 in Black, Blue, Light Green and Light Pink colourways.
title: Samsung Galaxy A27 5G Launched With Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 SoC, 6.7-Inch Display: Price, Specifications

description: The Oppo Reno 16 series is launching in India on July 02, 2026. The company will be launching Reno 16 and Reno 16c during the launch event, which is scheduled to be livestreamed on YouTube. Check out the first impression of the Reno 16 to know more about the design and some camera features.
title: Oppo Reno 16 First Impressions

description: GTA 6 pre-orders are now live on PS5 and Xbox Series S/X, and Sony has now started its marketing push for the game. The PlayStation parent has said that GTA 6 plays best on a PS5 and detailed DualSense features supported by the game. The PlayStation app icon has been changed, as well, to resemble GTA 6 colours.
title: Sony Starts Marketing Push for GTA 6, Says Game Will 'Play Best' on PS5

description: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE has reportedly been spotted on the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) certification database. The listing suggests that the smartphone could be launched in India soon. The phone was spotted with the model number SM-S741B/DS, with “DS” representing that the model number belongs to the Indian variant of the handset. The Samsung Galaxy S26 FE has previously been spotted on the WPC database with model number SM-S741, while appearing on the GSMA website with the model number SM-S741B/DS. The handset is expected to launch with support for a maximum load power of 5.0W. It has reportedly been Qi2 certified. It is said to ship with Android 17 and 8GB of RAM.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE India Launch Seems Imminent as Handset Gets Listed on BIS Database

description: Binance has withdrawn its Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) licence application filed with Greece’s Hellenic Capital Market Commission and plans to seek authorisation in another European Union member state. The move comes just days before the MiCA transition deadline of July 1, as crypto firms race to comply with the bloc’s new regulatory framework and maintain operations across the European Union.
title: Binance Withdraws MiCA Filing Submitted in Greece, Days Ahead of MiCA Deadline

description: Vivo Y05e is said to be in the works, and the saga surrounding the handset appears to continue. Recently, the phone was spotted on the Google Play Console with model number V2606. It is likely to feature an HD+ panel and a Unisoc chipset. The Vivo Y05e is likely to be positioned below the Vivo Y05 in the market. The listing shows the phone with the Android 16 operating system and 4GB RAM.
title: Vivo Y05e Listing on Google Play Console Confirms Smartphone's Key Specifications: Report

description: Lava Smart 4 Plus launched in India with a 6.75-inch display. It has an IP64-rated dust and water-resistant build. It runs on an octa-core Unisoc processor and has a 13-megapixel rear camera unit. It is priced at Rs. 9,999 for the sole 4GB RAM + 64GB storage variant in India. It is offered in Nilgiri blue and Himalayan Silver colour options.
title: Lava Smart 4 Plus Launched in India With 5,000mAh Battery, 6.75-Inch Display: Price, Specifications
Huion's 2026 India Lineup Defines Next-Gen Creativity
LG QNED Mini LED TVs: The Case for Colour, Control and Everyday Premium Viewing

description: OpenAI on Thursday unveiled its first custom-designed artificial intelligence (AI) accelerator called Jalapeno. It has been developed in collaboration with California-based semiconductor giant Broadcom. Instead of training, the San Francisco-based company describes it as an “Intelligence Processor” that is purpose-built for large language model (LLM) inference. It is claimed to deliver better performance per watt than current state-of-the-art solutions around the compute, memory, and networking requirements.
title: OpenAI Unveils First Custom AI Chip ‘Jalapeño’ to Deliver Faster LLM Inference, Power Next-Gen AI

description: Oppo Reno 16 series will be launched in India on July 2 at 12 pm IST, the smartphone maker announced on Thursday. This comes shortly after the company started teasing the debut of the upcoming Oppo Reno 16 and Reno 16c in the country. The two phones are confirmed to go on sale in India via Amazon and Flipkart. On top of this, the company has revealed the camera configuration of the upcoming Oppo Reno 16 series. The Oppo Reno 16 and Reno 16c will be equipped with triple rear camera units, headlined by a 50-megapixel primary shooter.
title: Oppo Reno 16, Reno 16c India Launch Date Revealed Along With Camera Configuration

description: Oppo Find X10 Ultra and Find X10 Pro Max are tipped to feature 6.89-inch LTPO displays with 2K resolution. The panels are said to feature narrow bezels and support BT.2020 colour gamut. The displays are said to be made with a new generation of luminescent material. BOE is expected to supply display panels for the upcoming phones.
title: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max, Find X10 Ultra Display Details Revealed in New Leak

description: Bitcoin hovered near $61,700 on Thursday as investors awaited the US Core PCE inflation report, a key indicator for future Federal Reserve policy. Analysts said weak institutional participation, continued ETF outflows, and uncertainty over interest rates kept sentiment subdued, while on-chain data suggested the market has yet to enter a capitulation phase.
title: Bitcoin's Price Steadies Near $61,600 Ahead of Key US Inflation Data

description: Apple might launch the iPhone 18 series with a more reasonable price hike than earlier expected, a JP Morgan analyst report estimates. The Cupertino-based tech giant is expected to raise the price of the lineup by $50 (about Rs. 4,800). The company reportedly plans to offset the increased manufacturing costs by equipping the iPhone 18 lineup with its proprietary Apple C series modems, instead of the Qualcomm modems found on the iPhone 17 Pro models. For reference, the iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 17 Pro Max were launched in India in September 2025 at starting prices of Rs. 1,34,900 and Rs. 1,49,900, respectively.
title: iPhone 18 Series Price Hike Said to Be Lower Than Previous Predictions, Despite Increasing Memory Costs

description: Rockstar Games has confirmed price and pre-order details for Grand Theft Auto 6, which is now available to pre-purchase on PS5 and Xbox Series S/X. The studio has also confirmed that the game will not get a disc version at launch. Instead, the physical release will come with a digital download code in the box.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Is Not Getting a Disc Version at Launch, Rockstar Confirms

description: Redmi K90 Ultra will be equipped with an 8,550mAh Xiaomi Jinshajiang battery, featuring 16 percent silicon content, the Xiaomi sub-brand announced on Thursday. The upcoming smartphone will also arrive with support for 100W wired fast charging and 22.5W wired reverse charging. This is a significant upgrade over the Redmi K80 Ultra, which is backed by a 7,410mAh battery. Moreover, the phone will sport a flat display with M10 luminescent material, offering up to a 165Hz refresh rate, up to 3,500 nits peak brightness, and Xiaomi Qingshan Eye Protection.
title: Redmi K90 Ultra Battery, Display Features Revealed, Tipster Claims It Outperforms Rival Snapdragon-Powered Flagships

description: OnePlus Nord Buds 4 were launched in India on Thursday. The true wireless stereo (TWS) earphones join the previously introduced Buds 4 Pro in the company’s latest Nord-branded audio lineup. They are claimed to provide active noise cancellation (ANC) up to 52 dB. The buds are equipped with larger titanium-coated dynamic drivers, Bluetooth 6.1 connectivity, AI-backed translation features, Game Spatial Audio, and IP55-rated dust and water resistance. OnePlus claims battery life of up to 54 hours with the charging case on the Nord Buds 4.
title: OnePlus Nord Buds 4 Launched in India With 52dB ANC, Up to 54-Hour Battery Life: Price, Specifications

description: Google Chrome is getting a new search feature. With this update, users no longer have to search for words when writing prompts with Gemini in Chrome. Google has updated its Gemini in Chrome support documentation to include the new Select from Screen feature. Users can click Ask Gemini in Chrome, then select the Plus icon to access this feature. This feature is a new way to interact with Gemini.
title: Gemini in Chrome Gets a New 'Select From Screen' Feature for Faster AI-Powered Searches

description: This week's OTT lineup is genuinely hard to ignore. House of the Dragon Season 3 kicks things off on JioHotstar, while Avatar: Fire and Ash and Avatar: The Last Airbender Season 2 keep the fantasy mood going across JioHotstar and Netflix. On the Indian content side, Gram Chikitsalay Season 2, Lingam, Perfect Family, Raja Shivaji, and the Baahubali documentary all land between June 23 and 26. Lock Upp Season 2 wraps up the week on Netflix from June 27.
title: New OTT Releases This Week (June 22 - June 28): Raja Shivaji, Gram Chikitsalay Season 2, Avatar Fire and Ash, Perfect Family, Lock Upp S2, and More

description: Google will let developers offer alternative payment systems and direct users to their own websites for purchases alongside Google Play's billing platform starting June 30. The move gives developers more flexibility in how they handle payments while reducing dependence on Google's in-app billing system. Google is also separating its Play Store service fee from its billing fee. Under the new structure, developers in the US, UK and EEA will pay a service fee starting at 10 percent on their first $1 million in annual earnings. The same service fee applicable for auto-renewing subscriptions.
title: Google Play Store to Allow External Payments From June 30 in Select Global Markets

description: Samsung is said to be fast-tracking the development of its next major Android operating system update. According to a report, the South Korean tech conglomerate is internally testing One UI 9, based on Android 17. The stable version of the update could reportedly be unveiled as early as July, alongside the company’s next-generation foldable smartphones. It is likely to carry user interface refinements and a handful of productivity features, instead of major visual changes.
title: Samsung Reportedly Expands One UI 9 Testing to More Galaxy Devices Ahead of Stable Android 17 Rollout

description: Apple has been rumoured to launch its first foldable iPhone this year alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. While the Cupertino-based tech giant has yet to acknowledge the handset, it is said to have entered its final stages of development. According to a report, Apple has completed the validation of key hardware components and is preparing to begin mass production as early as next month. The report also mentions that Samsung Display has secured approval to manufacture the foldable OLED panels, although the final word reportedly still rests on the hinge mechanism.
title: iPhone Ultra Reportedly Enters Final Production Stage Ahead of September Launch

description: Nothing officially revealed the design of its upcoming smartphone, the Nothing Phone 4b, on Thursday. The upcoming smartphone from the London-based technology startup is expected to arrive as the latest addition to the Phone 4 lineup, which already comprises the Nothing Phone 4a and Phone 4a Pro. The handset appears to sport the company’s signature transparent design language and a new Glyph Bar interface, while also borrowing several elements from the Phone 4a Pro.
title: Nothing Phone 4b Design Revealed Ahead of Launch as Company Confirms Blue Colourway, Glyph Bar

description: Apple has now clearly mentioned in a new section in Siri AI’s system prompt that the AI-powered voice assistant must not provide webpage summaries to users on the basis of the URL, according to a report. The report highlights that the system prompt has been updated to state, “You cannot access content behind a URL: When a user provides a URL and asks you to summarize, read, or extract information from it, inform them that you cannot access webpages. Do not offer follow-up suggestions or workarounds.” The change was spotted with the release of the latest second developer beta update of iOS 27.
title: iOS 27 Beta 2: Siri AI's System Prompt Reportedly Includes Instructions to Not Offer Webpage Summaries
